text:
helen: Heads-up — starting staggered unpin for cohort_stable_v3 in the 20:30 UTC window. plan: 0% -> 3% -> 15% -> 60% with 15m gates. we'll soft-pin model v8.3.0 for exposed requests and autoswap to v8.2.5 on error.

deploybot: scheduled job 20240815-llmroute-213 queued for 2024-08-15T20:30:00Z. will post step events.

tom: rollback triggers suggested: immediate drain to 0% if p95 up > 250ms OR 5xx rate +1% sustained for 5m, or if quality eval fails. also watch tokens/sec drop > 8%.

pager: monitors set: latency_p95, 5xx_rate, tokens_per_sec, quality_score. page on sev1 if p95 > 700ms OR 5xx > 2.5% for 3m. runbook: https://wiki/internal/rollouts#staggered-unpin

viv: release note snippet: "staged unpin of cohort_stable_v3 to validate routing with model v8.3.0; soft-pin per-step and fallback to v8.2.5." adding to draft. :memo:

helen: ops checklist (short):
```
- t+0 set cohort_stable_v3 = 3%
- wait 15m, run smoke/evals, check p95/5xx/tokens/sec/quality
- keep soft-pin v8.3.0 for 10m after each bump to prevent oscillation
- t+15 bump to 15% if green; then to 60% at t+30 if green
- fast-disable: `releases flag set cohort_stable_v3 0% --immediate`
```

tom: running smoke suite after each step, will paste perf deltas.

deploybot: step1 executed: cohort_stable_v3 = 3% (7100001180). next bump scheduled in 15m.

pager: telemetry snapshot: p95 +11ms, 5xx +0.03%, tokens/sec steady, quality_score stable. within gates.

helen: proceeding to 15% at t+15 unless anyone objects.

deploybot: step2 executed: cohort_stable_v3 = 15% (7100001240). holding for gating checks.

tom: smoke pass #2: p95 +28ms (okay), 5xx +0.1%, slight kv miss +0.4% — still under rollback. quality evals pass. green to continue.

viv: updated release notes with gate timings and pin policy. noted soft-pin 10m per-step.

helen: final bump to 60% planned at +15m if telemetry stays green. ops-oncall: @tom, @helen. fast-disable command in docs.

pager: reminder: if we need emergency rollback, sequence in runbook is fast-disable -> pin-back to v8.2.5 -> notify customers if extended.

helen: thanks all — will post final completion after cooldown. :white_check_mark:
